glossary.name: Lanternfall
glossary.simpleEnglish: The fog that comes when the lighthouse goes dark
glossary.explanation: When the Gull Rock lantern goes out, sea fog and worse roll inland. Relighting the Everflame ends it.
glossary.significance: The main quest of this campaign.

glossary.name: Wisp-glass
glossary.simpleEnglish: Glass left behind by a burnt-out wisp
glossary.explanation: Rare, warm to the touch and prized by tinkers and herbalists.
glossary.significance: A crafting material that also drops from wisps.

glossary.name: The Everflame
glossary.explanation: A braided wick said to have burned for a hundred years.
glossary.significance: Needed to relight the Gull Rock lantern.
